Single source -> medium, not independent. Seed citation (the monthly-reports/page/2 navigation index) is the same navigation-index defect as the current dead ref -- opened and rejected per rule 4; only one seed citation was on the brief.

Same table lists the 83 km/18 in Zeit Bay Facilities-Ras Gharib line among the region's eight named long-haul crude oil pipelines (alongside SUMED 320 km/42 in and Ras Shukheir-Assiut 280 km/20-22 in) -- an inter-facility trunk line of this scale is 'transmission' by inference (not gathering/distribution), the same reasoning basis this project uses for status inference. Word 'transmission' itself never appears; tier held at medium given the inference step. Single source, not independent.

Single source -> medium.
